cohort: Women aged 50 years and older who gave birth in Denmark, Finland, Norway, and Sweden between 1991 and 2013 (n=170 deliveries).
finding: The study found a high frequency of obstetric and neonatal complications among women aged 50 years and older, though some complications were less frequent than previously reported.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were high, at 50% for singleton pregnancies and 79% for multiple pregnancies.
